Q_38331_001.question: In 3GPP TS 38.331 (NR RRC), which timer is started by the UE upon transmission of RRCReconfigurationComplete including mobilityControlInfo?
Q_38331_001.explanation: According to TS 38.331 Section 5.3.5.3, timer T304 is started upon reception of RRCReconfiguration containing reconfigurationWithSync (Handover) and stopped upon successful random access to the target cell.

Q_38213_002.question: What is the primary cause of sudden Uplink PUSCH SINR degradation when RSRP from the serving gNB remains high (-75 dBm)?
Q_38213_002.option 2: Co-channel uplink inter-cell interference (high neighboring PRB load) or external jammer
Q_38213_002.explanation: High serving RSRP combined with severely degraded SINR indicates a high interference-plus-noise denominator, typically caused by uncoordinated co-channel PUSCH transmissions or pilot pollution.

Q_ORAN_003.question: In O-RAN architecture, which interface is responsible for connecting the Near-RT RIC to the E2 Nodes (O-CU-CP, O-CU-UP, O-DU) for fine-grained control loops (10ms-1s)?
Q_ORAN_003.explanation: The E2 interface connects the Near-RT RIC to E2 nodes (CU/DU) allowing xApps to subscribe to metrics and execute RAN control actions.

Q_38413_004.question: When an NG-RAN node rejects a PDU Session Resource Setup Request due to transport network congestion, which NGAP Cause group is signaled?
Q_38413_004.explanation: TS 38.413 Clause 9.3.1.2 defines CauseTransport for signaling failures stemming from GTP-U transport and IP backbone congestion.
